query:
SELECT c.zone_id, c.bloque,
                      EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM comptes.attribution_role a
                          WHERE a.compte_id = c.id
                            AND a.role = 'coursier'::comptes.role
                            AND a.statut = 'valide'::comptes.statut_role
                      ) AS "role_valide!"
               FROM comptes.compte c
               WHERE c.id = $1
